purpose: New exact-source whole-run, complete-task and full-grid readers; does not activate training or alter the predeclared nDCG estimand.
boundaries: A continuation-only directory must retain its full earlier checkpoint/timing prefix before whole-run acceptance. No timing is zero-imputed or inferred from another branch.
All five model/optimizer/scheduler payloads are deeply checked after content authentication; exact final inference weights and model/tokenizer semantics must match the terminal checkpoint.
The result reader requires finite normalized nDCG@10/main_score and exact task/model/runtime metadata. Upstream undefined unused nAUC is preserved and explicitly disclosed, not used or imputed.
All 12 complete runs precede any full-grid collection; all 840 distinct task cells are required. No missing optimizer/rate is dropped.

This is artifact acceptance only; new validation selection, outcome/statistical and mechanism/publication integration, natural-data execution readiness and the reviewed runtime handoff remain required.
